narrative.overview: code-server provides a precision developer workstation running full VS Code in the browser. The system balances high-density information architecture on desktop displays with ergonomic, touch-first affordances and transient navigation overlays on mobile phones.
keyCharacteristics: Dynamic viewport classification based on live geometry without reload
Minimum 44px touch targets on mobile viewports
Zero regressions to desktop keyboard, mouse, and multi-part layouts
Transient overlay navigation avoiding editor shrink on small screens

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls in mobile phone layout must maintain a minimum 44px hit target area.

rules.name: The Geometry Gate Rule
rules.body: Classify layout modes strictly using container geometry rather than user-agent sniffing.

rules.name: The Overlay Integrity Rule
rules.body: Mobile sidebars and panels must render as transient overlay surfaces above the editor rather than reclaiming editor grid width.

dos: Do use 44px minimum touch targets on mobile phone layouts.
Do rely on live container geometry for layout adaptation.
Do preserve VS Code native theme tokens across dark and light themes.
Do contain overscroll within lists and editors on mobile.
donts: Don't shrink editor grid dimensions when opening mobile sidebars or panels.
Don't use user-agent sniffing to determine layout modes.
Don't introduce custom gesture layers that conflict with VS Code's Gesture engine.
Don't compromise desktop mouse and keyboard shortcut workflows.
